variant_answers.text: A group has one or more characters: a single non-space character between spaces (or at an end of the string) is a one-character word.
Any whitespace character (space, tab, newline, ...) separates words.
A word is a run of letters, so a letter preceded by a digit or punctuation mark (as in "ab 1e") is not part of a word.
The last non-space character of txt: trailing spaces are ignored, as example R-EX-3 ("apple pi e " gives True) suggests.
Any character for which Python's str.isalpha() is true, including Latin-1 letters above code 127 such as é.
